intro: In Stormwind, a stubborn brawler keeps Bartleby's Mug close. A warrior must win it in a tavern brawl, then watch Bartleby drain his drink before he surrenders it.

p: Bartleby keeps his mug close, and a young warrior in Stormwind must wrest it from him. The stubborn brawler gives it up only after a fight leaves him beaten. Even then, Bartleby drains every last drop before handing over the mug as proof of victory.
